pv.name: PV — Planned Value
pv.formula: Baseline hours spread over baseline working days, to the as-of date
pv.reading: What the Baseline said would be earned by now

ac.name: AC — Actual Cost (all-in)
ac.formula: Actuals Ledger, attributed by the current Mapping

planned_scope.name: — of which planned scope
planned_scope.formula: AC of baselined WPs (incl. Catch-all within its Baseline)

unplanned_line.name: — of which Unplanned (PV = EV = 0)
unplanned_line.reading: Actual effort with no earned value

cpi_all_in.name: CPI (all-in)
cpi_all_in.reading: < 1 means over budget. This is the headline figure and the one every EAC uses.

cpi_planned.name: CPI (planned scope)
cpi_planned.formula: CPI = EV ÷ AC of baselined WPs
cpi_planned.reading: Higher than all-in CPI: the planned work is close to plan; the overrun is Unplanned Work.

tcpi.name: TCPI
tcpi.reading: > 1.1 means the remaining work must beat the planned efficiency — a red flag.

bac.name: BAC — Budget at Completion
bac.formula: Σ Baseline hours over baselined leaf WPs
